questions.q: In Quantum Field Theory, what is considered the fundamental building block of the universe?
questions.explanation: QFT proposes that continuous, vibrating fluid-like substances known as fields are fundamental, and particles are just excitations in these fields.

questions.q: What is the vacuum of space in QED?
options: Teeming with fluctuating fields and virtual photons
questions.explanation: In QFT, the vacuum is not truly empty; it contains fluctuating fields and virtual photons that constantly pop in and out of existence.
